name: Julius
overview: Julius was a Roman centurion entrusted with the custody of Paul and other prisoners during their voyage to Italy. Despite his official role, Julius showed kindness and respect toward Paul, allowing him to visit friends for refreshment. Later, when danger threatened, Julius demonstrated a desire to preserve Paul's life by preventing others from harming him and ordering those who could swim to escape first. These verses highlight Julius as a figure of authority who acted with compassion and integrity in the midst of difficult circumstances.
